name: OpenChamber
summary: Your OpenChamber sessions, approvals and usage in the notch
description:
OpenChamber puts the coding sessions you run in OpenChamber beside the notch: what is working, for how long, and which tool each session is in.

When a session asks for permission, a card appears on the notch with the exact command, and you allow it once or reject it without leaving what you are doing. The shelf widget keeps every pending request, with Always for the ones you trust. A second widget shows each plan's usage windows from OpenChamber's Usage page, and warns you as one passes 80% and 95%.

It watches every server OpenChamber Desktop on this Mac is set up for, this Mac's own and your remote hosts, using the tokens Desktop already has, so there is nothing to pair.
